A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same PRISM study. Their main text, figures, tables, equations, and appendices A-D are readable and support reliable comparison despite repagination.

before.justification: Section 4 reports original Sudoku, unconditional text-generation, and MBPP coding experiments. Appendix D includes additional numerical results and fine-tuning ablations.

after.justification: The same original experiments, numerical results, and appendix ablations are retained in v2.

M1.justification: PRISM's auxiliary quality head, binary-cross-entropy objective with MDM regularization, training procedure, and remasking/loop inference are unchanged (Section 3; Appendices B-C). The added concurrent-work comparison describes the existing method.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same Sudoku corpus, OpenWebText generation task, opc-sft-stage2 code fine-tuning data, and MBPP evaluation. No evaluated dataset, domain, or test scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged in Figures 3-4 and Tables 1-2, including the corresponding ReMDM variants and vanilla MDM/MDLM comparisons. Newly cited concurrent methods are discussed without being added as empirical baselines.

E3.justification: Section 4 and Appendix D retain the same data splits, 5,000 generated text samples, evaluation metrics, model configurations, training budgets, sampling steps, and LLaDA remasking-parameter sweeps.

E4.justification: The Sudoku token-quality case study and ablations of the training parameters k, n_y, and nucleus-sampling probability remain unchanged (Figure 3; Appendix D.3-D.4; Figures 5-6). No additional analysis is introduced.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run counts, random seeds, confidence intervals, or significance tests. The figures and tables retain the same uncertainty-reporting practices.

E6.justification: The numerical tables, plotted results, and reported findings are unchanged, including Appendix D. For example, Table 1 retains PRISM's MBPP scores of 23.0%, 30.5%, and 32.9% at 256, 512, and 1024 sampling steps.

T1.justification: The per-token-quality definitions, Propositions 1-2, their proofs, and the masking-process equivalence derivation remain unchanged (Section 3.1; Appendix B).

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution statements, and conclusion retain the same claims of lightweight, theoretically grounded self-correction across three domains. The new introductory motivation repeats the few-step advantage already discussed in v1's conclusion.

C2.justification: Appendix A newly acknowledges that Huang et al. (2025) evaluate LLaDA across more tasks and datasets than PRISM, adding a specific comparative qualification of empirical scope. Existing interpretations and limitations concerning diversity and global reasoning errors remain unchanged.

D1.justification: Implementation details, hyperparameters, hardware and training-time descriptions, and data-source/access information are unchanged, including Table 3 and Appendix D.5-D.6.

R1.justification: V2 adds Kang, Meshchaninov, Li, and Huang et al. (2025). New introductory and Appendix A paragraphs position concurrent approaches and compare PRISM with Huang's method in theoretical guarantees, training-sample construction, and experimental scope. The existing related-work framework is retained.

P1.justification: V2 adds short 'Why self-correction?' and 'Concurrent work' paragraphs, an Appendix A comparison paragraph, and a small wording adjustment to PRISM's expanded name. Most prose and the section organization remain unchanged.

P2.justification: All six figures and three tables retain their designs and content. Page reflow changes display placement relative to the prose; for example, Figure 2 precedes Proposition 1 in v2 instead of following its proof.

improvement.justification: The added concurrent-work discussion, especially the explicit comparison with Huang et al. in Appendix A, improves scholarly context and clarifies PRISM's distinctions and comparative experimental scope. Bringing the existing motivation into the introduction modestly improves readability. The method, proofs, and empirical evidence remain unchanged.
